description: Fork of exp104 with extreme sparse-scatter regime: each table emits a single scalar (n_sparse_outputs=1) into the scatter, but tables are large (nap=10, table_dim=1024) and numerous (qk/v tph=768, out tph=4096). Net per-layer LUT weight count matches exp104 (qk/v: 6*768*1024*1=4.72M, out: 1*4096*1024*1=4.19M per layer). Distinguishing factor: many small per-table contributions vs fewer 8-vector contributions. Other settings (E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip, linear unembedder) match exp104.
